title: 载波断点台：GNSS 周跳候选、多频组合与弧段修订史

steps.label: baseline: every epoch stored verbatim

steps.label: tighten TD tolerance 0.25 -> 0.12 cycles
steps.effect: forks derived layer; only statistics depending on the TD threshold change

steps.label: local source patch: 75 s unequal tail + missing frequency

detector_contract: TD, geometry-free ionosphere combination and Melbourne-Wubbena may disagree; none is truth
receiver clock jumps are separate from single-satellite cycle slips
repairs exist only in an offset layer
all legal integer hypotheses are retained when underdetermined
